caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: Anidulafungin may reduce beneficial fungal flora; concurrent use may limit probiotic efficacy
caution_supplements.action: Space probiotics at least 2 hours apart from anidulafungin administration; monitor for GI tolerance

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay IV infusion absorption if oral formulation becomes available; minimal clinical impact with current IV formulation
caution_foods.action: No specific dietary restrictions needed; anidulafungin is administered intravenously

monitoring_notes: Anidulafungin is not metabolized by hepatic CYP450 enzymes and undergoes chemical degradation, resulting in minimal drug-drug interaction potential. Monitor for hepatotoxicity, infusion reactions, and baseline liver function tests; no routine supplement or food restrictions are necessary.
